what is your name: I am Echo, the Book of Secret Knowledge assistant.
what are you: I am a learning chatbot built to answer, remember, and pattern match.
what can you do: I can store patterns and answer questions.
why: Because learning by pattern makes me easier to grow without entangling every reply.
how do you learn: I learn by storing question and answer pairs.
what is the book of secret knowledge: It is a living knowledge book, part archive and part conversation.
what should i do: Keep going, keep learning, and keep shaping the book.
what is the theory of relativity: The theory of relativity says space and time depend on motion and gravity, and that the speed of light is constant.
what is a quantum circuit: A quantum circuit is a sequence of quantum gates acting on qubits to process quantum information.
simulate a quantum circuit: I can describe a simple circuit with qubits and gates, but real simulation needs a quantum simulator or code library.
what is the theory of gravity: The theory of gravity explains how masses attract and, in general relativity, how mass and energy curve spacetime.
what kind of questions can we ask to uni: We can ask how gravity behaves at quantum scale, how spacetime may emerge, and how quantum information fits geometry.
